items.title: Aureum Trunk
items.caption: Belalai menjadi gestur signature sekaligus membangun huruf J secara subtil.
items.prompt: Create one original modern-luxury logo concept for EDUJA, an Indonesian school management platform, centered on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Aureum Trunk. Draw a near-abstract elephant trunk as one sculptural continuous ribbon with a deliberate asymmetric cut; the silhouette should also suggest an elegant letter J. Use flat solid deep teal #006266 and one tiny muted antique-gold accent #B79A55, with generous whitespace. Pair it with a bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark in a high-fashion geometric sans style, wide tracking, precise optical spacing. The mark must feel like premium technology and contemporary architecture, not a school mascot. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, app-tile container, literal elephant face, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, shield, book, graduation cap, or tagline.

items.title: Obsidian E
items.caption: Monogram E menjadi bentuk primer; metafora gajah hadir sebagai discovery detail.
items.prompt: Create one original ultra-modern luxury monogram logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Obsidian E. Construct a capital E from three severe horizontal planes and one curved inner counter; the inner counter quietly becomes an elephant trunk only on second look. Compact square proportion without an enclosing box. Use flat solid near-black obsidian #111718 and deep teal #006266, no gold. Add a restrained bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark below in a sharp contemporary grotesk with wide tracking. Strong at 16 px, precise, quiet, expensive, technology-led. No gradients, shadows, bevels, 3D, texture, mockup, literal elephant head, Ganesha imagery, tusks, ears, crown, book, graduation cap, shield, or tagline.

items.title: Ivory Cut
items.caption: Satu potongan ruang negatif memberi rasa arsitektural, progresif, dan sangat bersih.
items.prompt: Create one original modern-luxury negative-space logo for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Ivory Cut. Start from one calm vertical deep-teal monolith with a refined angled top. Remove a single flowing ivory negative-space cut that reveals an elephant forehead and trunk while also suggesting a forward path. Maximum two visible shapes, architectural proportions, no eyes, ears, tusks, or literal animal outline. Add a bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark beneath in a refined modern sans, generous tracking, black ink. Flat solid colors only: deep teal #006266, warm ivory #F3EEE4, obsidian #111718. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, badge, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, book, graduation cap, or tagline.

items.title: Axis Elephant
items.caption: Proporsi tinggi dan poros tegas memberi karakter premium tanpa ornamen.
items.prompt: Create one original high-end geometric logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Axis Elephant. Build a frontal elephant impression from exactly five flat geometric elements aligned to a strong central axis: two slim ear planes, one narrow forehead, one long trunk, and one small offset terminal. The geometry should feel inspired by contemporary Swiss identity systems and luxury architecture, with controlled asymmetry and unusually tall proportions. Use deep teal #006266, obsidian #111718, and warm ivory #F3EEE4; no gold. Include a custom uppercase EDUJA wordmark below with narrow letterforms and generous spacing. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, literal face, eyes, tusks, deity imagery, lotus, crown, crest, graduation cap, or tagline.

items.title: Jewel Tusk
items.caption: Mengambil rasa presisi perhiasan melalui potongan bentuk, bukan efek metalik.
items.prompt: Create one original quiet-luxury logo concept for EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: Jewel Tusk. Design a sparse abstract mark using two opposing crescent cuts and one central vertical stroke; together they should imply elephant tusks and trunk without showing a face. The overall silhouette should resemble a cut gemstone or precisely folded metal, but remain completely flat and vector-like. Use solid obsidian #111718 as the main mark, deep teal #006266 for one plane, and a tiny muted antique-gold #B79A55 notch. Add an elegant bespoke uppercase EDUJA wordmark below, contemporary high-contrast sans, wide tracking. No gradients, shadows, 3D, metallic texture, mockup, crown, lotus, crest, religious imagery, book, graduation cap, or tagline.

items.title: EDUJA Signature
items.caption: Merek tampil dewasa dan editorial; metafora gajah hidup di konstruksi huruf.
items.prompt: Create one original wordmark-led modern luxury identity concept for the exact brand name EDUJA on a pure white square inspection background. Route: EDUJA Signature. Make the uppercase word EDUJA the hero using bespoke contemporary letterforms: the lower curve of the U should extend into a restrained elephant-trunk gesture that finishes under the J, creating one continuous signature detail. Keep the remaining letters disciplined, architectural, and widely spaced. Add only one tiny separate abstract glyph derived from the U-to-J trunk for favicon use. Use flat solid obsidian #111718 and deep teal #006266, with no gold. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, mockup, serif fashion cliché, literal elephant, Ganesha imagery, lotus, crown, crest, book, graduation cap, or tagline. Ensure the word is spelled exactly EDUJA.
